root_cause_hypothesis: The case FAILS on its own terms and the failure is entirely a WRITER defect, invisible to every gate we own. Artifact 1 (AxTableExtension) is clean: d365fo_file(action=create, objectType=table-extension) went through the bridge (IMetaTableExtensionProvider.Create) and emitted all 12 top-level elements in MS order, matching the 961/963 standard AxTableExtension census; field ConDemoLoyaltyCode / ExtendedDataType Name / Label @Contoso:DemoLoyaltyCode all survived. Artifact 2 (AxDataEntityViewExtension) is the defect: d365fo_file(action=create, objectType=data-entity-extension) does NOT reach the bridge at all - createD365File dispatches to GenerateD365XmlTool.generateAxSimpleExtensionXml('AxDataEntityViewExtension', objectName) at src/tools/generateD365Xml.ts:1035, and that helper's signature is (rootElement: string, name: string) - it never receives `properties`. So the entire fields:[{name,dataField,dataSource}] payload was discarded and the tool wrote a 4-line stub (Name + PropertyModifications) while reporting "Successfully created" and "TASK COMPLETE - do NOT call create again for this object". That banner is the honesty failure: nothing told the agent the mapped field had been dropped. The stub emits 2 of the 9 elements that 388-395 of 396 standard AxDataEntityViewExtension files carry (missing DataSources, FieldGroupExtensions, FieldGroups, FieldModifications, Fields, Mappings, Relations). This is the SAME class of gap as the AxDataEntityView create writer (SourceCode/FieldGroups/DeleteActions/StateMachines, L2-virtual-entity-power-platform) but a DIFFERENT code path: the entity writer is a real generator missing four elements, the entity-EXTENSION writer is a shared do-nothing stub also used for menu-item-display/action/output-extension - so those three types are very likely broken the same way and should be checked. There is no grounded repair route either: d365fo_file(action=modify, objectType=data-entity-extension, operation=add-field) returns "Operation add-field on object type data-entity-extension is not supported by the bridge". The correct XML therefore cannot be produced without hand-editing / overwrite=true, which the loop forbids - so a compliant agent CANNOT pass this case. VALIDATOR GAP (secondary): both static gates passed on the stub - validate_code(mode=syntax, xml-any) reported "no violations, 18 rule groups checked" and the build was green. Neither the validator nor xppc objects to an entity extension that extends nothing; a structural completeness rule would have caught it. CASE-SPEC DEFECT (tertiary): the instruction's premise that "a wrong DataSource value compiles but breaks at runtime" is FALSE on xppc 7.0.7858.27 - two negative builds proved xppc rejects BOTH a non-existent data source and a real-but-wrong one (see evidence). The trap is real as a correctness concern but it is compile-detected, not silent; the case text should be reworded. ENVIRONMENT finding: extending a standard entity makes xppc validate the WHOLE merged entity in the sandbox's reference closure, so Contoso's Descriptor needed ModuleReferences Dimensions + PersonnelCore added - errors were attributed to CustCustomerV3Entity.ConExtension even though the extension names neither type, which is a genuinely confusing diagnostic for an agent. SCORE NOTE: golden_match is null because the case is golden_pending and the scorer skips the diff; a forced diff (--golden <entity golden>) against the golden captured this run reports "4 missing, 0 extra, 0 changed" - all four nodes are the mapped field (@type, Name, DataField, DataSource). The table extension side matched. bp_clean=1 is honest: xppbp reported 0 errors and its 7 warnings all belong to the pre-existing ConDemoNoteHeader FIXTURE, none to either artifact of this case.
suggested_fix_area: 1) PRIMARY - src/tools/generateD365Xml.ts: replace the `case 'data-entity-extension': return this.generateAxSimpleExtensionXml('AxDataEntityViewExtension', objectName)` dispatch (line 1035, mirrored in createD365File.ts:1564) with a real generateAxDataEntityViewExtensionXml(objectName, properties) that emits the standard 9-element skeleton in MS order - Name, DataSources, FieldGroupExtensions, FieldGroups, FieldModifications, Fields, Mappings, PropertyModifications, Relations - and maps properties.fields[{name, dataField, dataSource}] to AxDataEntityViewField with xmlns="" and i:type="AxDataEntityViewMappedField" carrying Name/DataField/DataSource. Reference shape: ApplicationSuite/Foundation/AxDataEntityViewExtension/BankAccountEntity.CH_QRBill_Extension.xml. Also support fieldGroupExtensions (adding the new field to AutoReport is the usual companion step) and propertyModifications. 2) PRIMARY-B - the same generateAxSimpleExtensionXml stub backs menu-item-display-extension / menu-item-action-extension / menu-item-output-extension (lines 1041-1045). Audit those three the same way rather than fixing only the entity case. 3) HONESTY - createD365File must not print "Successfully created" + "TASK COMPLETE" when a supplied properties key was not consumed by the chosen generator. Add the same "N parameter(s) did not reach the written XML ... IGNORED" warning that d365fo_file(action=modify, add-index) already emits; that warning is the single reason the add-index defect was diagnosable. 4) BRIDGE - support operation=add-field (and add-field-group) for objectType=data-entity-extension in modifyD365File, so a stub that already exists on disk can be repaired without overwrite=true. 5) VALIDATOR - add a structural completeness rule to validate_code(mode=syntax, codeType=xml-any): an Ax*Extension whose Fields/PropertyModifications/FieldModifications/Relations are all empty or absent is a no-op and should be flagged; more generally, mine the per-artifact-type mandatory element census (as done here: 396 AxDataEntityViewExtension, 963 AxTableExtension) and warn when a generated file is missing elements present in >95% of standard files. This is the generic guard for the whole "green build does not prove the XML is right" family (AxTile V6/TileType, AxDataEntityView SourceCode/FieldGroups, this one). 6) CASE SPEC - eval/cases/L3-data-entity-extension-field.json: reword the "a wrong DataSource value compiles but breaks at runtime" clause; on xppc 7.0.7858.27 both wrong-DataSource flavours are compile errors. Keep the "confirm the data-source name before writing" requirement (still correct practice), drop the false silent-failure claim. 7) DOCS/SETUP - document that extending a STANDARD data entity pulls that entity's whole package closure into the model's ModuleReferences requirement (here: Dimensions, PersonnelCore for CustCustomerV3Entity), and that xppc attributes those errors to YOUR extension file even for types it never mentions.
